sources.title: RFC 792: Internet Control Message Protocol
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ICMPv6：錯誤回報速率預算
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：可報告8與14 ms觀測差，但不可將它們命名為已量得的單向鏈路延遲。 交接時須能核對：交付 trace-join.csv、路徑假說圖與不可識別項目清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Report8 and14 ms observed differences without labeling them measured one-way link delays. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver trace-join.csv, path hypotheses and a list of unidentifiable quantities.
related.difference: 以時間序列記錄tokens與錯誤事件，將70與40視為可供應上界而非保證回應數。
related.differenceEn: Trace tokens and error events; treat70 and40 as supply upper bounds, not guaranteed reply counts.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Time Exceeded 暴露TTL耗盡的觀測；各跳回應可走不同回程，不能直接相減成單向鏈路延遲。
教學基準：18-10 = 8 ms；對照：24-10 = 14 ms。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

ICMPv6錯誤訊息需限制速率；低回應率不等同低原始錯誤率。
教學基準：min(100,20+5*10) = 70 messages；對照：min(100,20+2*10) = 40 messages。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Time Exceeded exposes TTL expiry; replies may use different return paths, so hop RTT differences are not one-way link delays.
Teaching baseline: 18-10 = 8 ms; comparison: 24-10 = 14 ms. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

ICMPv6 error messages require rate limiting; a low reply rate does not imply a low underlying error rate.
Teaching baseline: min(100,20+5*10) = 70 messages; comparison: min(100,20+2*10) = 40 messages. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: VXLAN：內外層 MTU 與 VNI 隔離
related.titleEn: VXLAN: inner/outer MTU and VNI isolation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：可報告8與14 ms觀測差，但不可將它們命名為已量得的單向鏈路延遲。 交接時須能核對：交付 trace-join.csv、路徑假說圖與不可識別項目清單。

related.difference: 為兩個VNI建立outer tuple與inner MAC表，逐層計算內層IP預算。
related.differenceEn: Build outer-tuple and inner-MAC tables for two VNIs and compute the inner-IP budget layer by layer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

VXLAN以UDP封裝內層Ethernet；VNI隔離語意不能由外層IP位址替代。
教學基準：1500-20-8-8-14 = 1450 B；對照：1500-40-8-8-14 = 1430 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Teaching baseline: 18-10 = 8 ms; comparison: 24-10 = 14 ms. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

VXLAN encapsulates inner Ethernet in UDP; outer IP addresses do not substitute for VNI isolation.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-8-8-14 = 1450 B; comparison: 1500-40-8-8-14 = 1430 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
